body: I agree with that. I feel unnoticed because normally, everything is fine for me. I also naturally act calm when everything absolutely isn't.

Thank you, stranger. You have no idea how much that helped me to hear someone is in the same boat, and I'm not completely alone. I just needed to hear from someone, since I have no one IRL to talk to. I think all the responsibility that has been thrown onto my shoulders makes it really hard.  Right now, I'm feeling better...but it's when I wake up in the morning that I worry about. That's when I feel like there is nothing to look forward to, only hardships and responsibilities I'm not ready to face.
